summary: The hardened workflow derives SESOI from paired same-seed dt/2-versus-dt/4 discretization differences, promotes E0 calibration to a tracked checksum-bound dependency, adds per-run fingerprinted recovery, and introduces a non-evidentiary B0 dynamics pilot. All 118 tests plus B0/E0-E3 local and umi preflights pass under source commit 029820d0161941b88cbf73580f0ccc557608a392. Deterministic inputs are prepared for 3/25/80/160/240 runs respectively, all matching audits pass, and the E1-E3 candidate-lock audits match. No numerical experiment has executed; the next boundary is explicit approval of a B0 cap of 12 CPU-hours, 2 wall-clock hours and 0 GPU.

blocking_findings.finding: The confirmatory parameter lock is deliberately candidate-only and numerical_calibration_sha256 remains pending until B0 and E0 complete.
blocking_findings.required_action: Approve the proposed B0 cap of 12 CPU-hours, 2 wall-clock hours and 0 GPU; use only runtime/stability/health diagnostics to finalize or revise the candidate, then separately budget E0 and bind its tracked calibration SHA-256 before E1-E3.

blocking_findings.finding: No numerical experiment has an approved compute budget; generic instructions to continue do not define a CPU-hour ceiling.
blocking_findings.required_action: Record explicit human approval for the B0 cap before invoking the runner without --prepare-only.

non_blocking_assets: The engine accepts explicit initial-condition CSV files, so non-degenerate wealth perturbations can be preregistered.
The engine accepts arbitrary ASCII terrain grids, so exact matched landscapes can be generated outside the simulator.
Configuration supports fixed population by disabling reproduction and setting mortality mechanisms to zero or off.
Output directories are configurable and can be kept inside each job workspace.
Random seeds and time step are configurable.
implementation_order: Obtain a small explicit B0 CPU-time budget and finalize or revise the candidate lock using only outcome-blind health diagnostics.
Execute E0, commit its tracked calibration result and bind its SHA-256 into E1-E3 before any confirmatory execution.

resolved_findings.finding: Formal drift, integrated-autocorrelation-time and effective-sample-size diagnostics now generate stationarity_report.json and block E0 calibration when any run fails.
E0 is bound to hardened source commit 029820d0161941b88cbf73580f0ccc557608a392, passes local and umi preflight, and has 25 deterministic inputs prepared without execution.
The active C++ core was built in Release mode on umi and its cycle1_channels CTest passed.
E1 and E2 are bound to hardened source commit 029820d0161941b88cbf73580f0ccc557608a392, pass local and umi preflight, and have 80 and 160 deterministic inputs prepared without execution.
Candidate parameter lock 0cebeee490f96cf88d886c243869d7efd5004afdc50e2ae8bf851ea4adf17352 is checksum-enforced for preparation, while the runner blocks E1-E3 execution until its status becomes final.
E3 correlated-random-field holdouts and cross-scale analysis remain implemented under hardened source commit 029820d0161941b88cbf73580f0ccc557608a392; the full suite now contains 118 passing tests.
The runner now records fingerprinted completion markers and safely reuses only runs whose binary, config, inputs, thread count, snapshot count and final snapshot checksum still match.
E0 writes a tracked calibration artifact; E1-E3 require its exact SHA-256 before binary execution, preventing untracked workspace calibration from becoming a cross-device dependency.

B0/E0-E3 pass local and umi preflight with 3/25/80/160/240 deterministic runs prepared; all matched-input audits pass and E1-E3 candidate-lock audits bind 0cebeee490f96cf88d886c243869d7efd5004afdc50e2ae8bf851ea4adf17352.

technical_notes: umi requires PYTHONPATH=src for module-style foundation CLI calls because the package is not installed into the system Python.
GCC 12.2 emits a non-blocking -Wrestrict warning in the inherited ic_loader.cpp implementation; it should be isolated before a release-quality build.
